name: Rina Pascal
source:
A woman who serves as the leader of the Holy Knights.

She is an elite member of the aristocratic class, and is the descendant of a female knight from the Fileille Holy Women's Squad who once participated in the extermination squad.

A dignified woman who combines grace and dignity, she is the most skilled of all the knights, and is also famous as a commander with a wealth of tactics and strategies.

However, due to her pride as an elite, she can also be a little arrogant, and perhaps because she is in charge of the Knights, she also lacks flexibility in her thinking. To put it simply, she is strict.

In general, she is loved and trusted by her subordinates, but some of them are dissatisfied with being looked down upon due to their lowly family background.
